products.title: Polar LeakFix Fibred Roof Coating | Waterproof Roof Sealant
products.body_html:
Polar LeakFix Fibred Roof Coating is a high-performance fibred and rubberised roof sealant designed to seal leaks and cracks while instantly waterproofing exterior surfaces. Our flexible, UV-resistant membrane helps protect against damp and weather-related damage across flat and pitched roofs, gutters, windows, pipework and drainpipes.

Suitable for asphalt, roofing felt, bitumen, brick, concrete, stone, tiles, grout, wood, fibreglass, metal and lead, it is ideal for felt roof sealant, felt roof repair, flat roof repair, shed maintenance and general exterior repairs.

No primer is required: simply prepare the surface, stir well and apply directly with a brush or roller. One generous coat is normally sufficient, with a second coat potentially required on porous or challenging surfaces after 2-3 days. Touch dry in 3-4 hours and fully cured within 6-7 days, with coverage of approximately 1m² per litre.

Key Features

Seals Leaks & Waterproofs Instantly: Our waterproof roof sealant is a high-performance fibred and rubberised coating designed to seal leaks, cracks and damaged exterior surfaces. It forms a strong, flexible membrane that helps protect against damp and weather damage, making it ideal for emergency repairs and ongoing roof maintenance.

Made For Roofs & Exterior Repairs: Our roof sealant is suitable for flat and pitched roofs, gutters, windows, pipework and drainpipes. Use on asphalt, bitumen, brick, concrete, stone, tiles, grout, wood, fibreglass, metal and lead, making it a versatile flat roof repair and exterior maintenance solution.

Easy To Apply With No Primer: Clear moss and debris, remove surface water and clean away oil, grease and dirt before application. Stir well and apply directly without primer using a brush or roller. One generous coat is normally enough, although porous or challenging surfaces may require a second coat after 2-3 days.

1m² Coverage Per Litre: Our roof sealer waterproof black coating covers approximately 1m² per litre, depending on the surface and application method. It is touch dry in 3-4 hours and completely cured within 6-7 days. Ideal for felt roof repair, gutters, sheds and general exterior maintenance where reliable waterproofing is needed.

Protecting Homes Since 1890: At Polar we are proud of our British heritage, with over 130 years of paint manufacturing experience. Our specialist paints and coatings are designed to help you renovate, revive and protect your home with confidence. Combining trusted quality with a customer-first approach, we're here to help you get the job done right. Please note that packaging may vary as we update our branding.

products.title: Polar Bathroom Paint | Moisture & Mould Resistant Satin Paint for Bathrooms & Kitchens
products.body_html:
Polar Bathroom Paint is a water-based, low-odour bathroom emulsion developed for high-condensation areas such as bathrooms and kitchens. It provides a hard-wearing, washable and wipeable finish that resists moisture, grease and everyday stains, while offering up to 10-year mould protection to help keep suitable interior surfaces cleaner for longer.

Our bathroom wall paint provides excellent opacity to help conceal imperfections and refresh surfaces with ease, making it a practical choice for decorating areas exposed to regular condensation and everyday household use. The White Satin finish is suitable for interior concrete, plaster, drywall, wood and painted surfaces, giving you flexibility across a range of decorating projects.

Our moisture resistant paint is straightforward to apply: ensure the surface is clean, dry and free from contamination, remove loose material from unsound coatings and lightly abrade smooth or glossy surfaces before painting. Stir thoroughly and apply by brush or roller in dry conditions at a minimum temperature of 10°C. Two coats are recommended for optimal and lasting results.

The paint dries in 1-2 hours at 20°C, although drying will take longer in colder conditions, and coverage is approximately 12m² per litre depending on the application method, substrate and temperature.

Whether you're looking for bathroom ceiling paint, kitchen paint, washable bathroom paint or white bathroom paint, Polar Bathroom Paint provides a practical, hard-wearing finish for interior areas where moisture, grease, stains and mould protection matter.

Key Features

Made For High-Condensation Areas: Our bathroom paint is a water-based, low-odour emulsion developed for bathrooms, kitchens and other high-condensation areas. It provides up to 10-year mould protection while resisting moisture, grease and everyday stains, helping keep interior surfaces cleaner for longer.

Washable & Wipeable Finish: Our bathroom wall paint provides a hard-wearing finish that can be washed and wiped clean, making everyday maintenance easier. Designed to resist moisture, grease and stains, the White Satin coating helps maintain a clean, practical appearance on suitable interior surfaces.

Excellent Opacity & Easy Coverage: Our bathroom emulsion provides excellent opacity to help conceal imperfections and refresh tired surfaces. One litre covers approximately 12m², although coverage varies with application method, substrate and temperature. Suitable for concrete, plaster, drywall, wood and previously painted surfaces.

Simple Application & Quick Drying: Ensure the surface is clean, dry and free from contamination before use, sanding unsound coatings and lightly abrading smooth or glossy surfaces. Stir thoroughly and apply by brush or roller in dry conditions above 10°C. Two coats are recommended; dry in 1-2 hours at 20°C.

Protecting Homes Since 1890: At Polar we are proud of our British heritage, with over 130 years of paint manufacturing experience. Our specialist paints and coatings are designed to help you renovate, revive and protect your home with confidence. Combining trusted quality with a customer-first approach, we're here to help you get the job done right.

products.title: Polar Water-Based Dampseal | Interior Damp Proof Paint
products.body_html:
Struggling with penetrating damp ruining your walls? Fed up with stains breaking through fresh paint?

Polar Water-Based Dampseal is a premium damp proofing paint designed to block, seal, and prevent penetrating damp from affecting interior walls and ceilings. Rather than masking the issue, it creates a durable moisture barrier that stops damp at its source—leaving you with a smooth, clean finish ready for redecorating.

Low odour and fast drying, it’s ideal for use in occupied homes where quick results matter.

Why Use Water-Based Dampseal?

With powerful sealing properties, Polar Water-Based Dampseal forms an instant moisture barrier that prevents damp from pushing through internal surfaces.

Whether you’re dealing with persistent damp patches in bedrooms, moisture around windows and door frames, or stains on kitchen and bathroom ceilings, this reliable solution tackles the problem quickly and effectively.

Key Features
Blocks Damp Instantly

Specially formulated to block penetrating damp, preventing moisture from resurfacing and damaging interior décor.

Versatile Interior Use

Suitable for plaster, cement, brick, wood, and stone. Ideal for interior walls and ceilings where damp has appeared.

Low Odour & Fast Drying

Water-based formulation makes it easy to apply in occupied spaces. Touch dry in 2–3 hours, with a second coat after 4 hours.

Easy Application

Apply using a brush, roller, or airless spray. Covers up to 11m² per litre, depending on surface porosity.

Smooth Matt Finish

Leaves a clean matt finish that can be left as-is or painted over with emulsion for fast redecoration.

Preparation & Application

Ensure surfaces are clean, dry, and free from grease, dirt, or loose material.
Treat any mould growth with bleach or an anti-mould spray and allow to dry fully before application.

Apply evenly and allow recommended drying times between coats for best results.

Ideal For

Interior walls and ceilings in bathrooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and living rooms

Areas around windows, doors, and frames prone to penetrating damp

Domestic and public buildings

Small repairs or full wall treatments

Order Polar Water-Based Dampseal Today

If you’re looking for a low-odour, fast-drying damp proof paint that seals moisture instantly and allows quick redecoration, Polar Water-Based Dampseal is the perfect solution.

Available in White and Magnolia, in 500ml, 1L, 2.5L, and 5L tins to suit projects of any size.

Waterproofs Instantly: Seals leaks and cracks as soon as it goes on.

Flexible Rubber Membrane: Stays flexible, so the seal moves with the surface beneath.
